Author: Serpens66
Name: Bugfixes and QoL
Description: Bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements for Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Fix AIV/AIC remember feature to not load new changes to these files
Added a host setting, enabled by default, that allows normal multiplayer lobbies to fill every available player slot with AI.
Fixed multiplayer matches remaining paused because an unpause request could not execute while the simulation was stopped.
Add the shared Mod Settings search with title, optional tooltip and section filtering, safe global-search handoff, and automatic text-field focus.
Replace the multiplayer game-speed toggle with Disabled, Only Host, and Everyone permissions shared by synchronized game-speed and pause controls.
Added the standard portrait background to the selected custom-lord preview and fixed Up/Down arrow keys navigating the background map list instead of the open custom-lord list.

Restricted the in-game Steam invitation prompt to validated invitations from current friends and added a local per-user prompt blacklist with detailed popup-suppression warnings; Steam's own invitation handling remains unchanged.
Added a portrait preview for the selected custom lord and made the random-lord button visually distinct.
Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Improved Assassin pathfinding now allows wall climbs to start and end on walkable reserved building areas, such as barracks forecourts.
Fixed Vanilla's default Congratulations overlay remaining visible behind the live statistics screen for players who joined the match as spectators.
Scopes per-player identity diagnostics to the authenticated sender and includes the finalized Script Extender synchronization workaround.
Extends the shared multiplayer settings workaround to retain authenticated per-player updates until Vanilla exposes their authoritative player slots.
Hardened multiplayer surrender authentication by resolving the transport sender exclusively through the authoritative active in-game roster.

Fixed the game intermittently replacing the user's loaded borderless display resolution with another resolution during startup or focus changes, while continuing to allow intentional changes made through the options menu.
Reduced the resolution diagnostic overhead and log volume while retaining detailed diagnostics for actual display-setting changes.
Fixed incoming Steam lobby invitation prompts not appearing in the multiplayer lobby browser or on the post-game statistics screen.
Fixed the selected map and its presentation not being restored for the host after returning to the multiplayer lobby at the end of a match.
Fixed intermittent multiplayer resyncs when surrendering by using a minimal synchronized payload and resolving and validating the surrendering player's Lord locally on every peer.
Fixed the Save / Load AIV and AIC preset delete and overwrite confirmations not appearing in the Skirmish and multiplayer frontend.
minor code improvments
Optimized event-driven AI tower-ruin tracking with constant-time building-ID lookups while retaining global-ID reuse protection.
Finalized AI tower-ruin rebuilding by removing obsolete placement diagnostics while retaining selective Vanilla cleanup routing in both native branches.
Applied selective AI tower-ruin cleanup routing in both Vanilla placement branches, including targets inside the keep-centered cleanup area.
Fixed AI tower-ruin cleanup routing by reading the tower mapper from its preserved native stack argument after Vanilla reuses RSI for the blocking building ID.
Corrected the audited native classifier signature so runtime-created same-owner AI tower ruins are actually routed through Vanilla's obstruction cleanup.
Fixed Vanilla AI tower rebuilding outside the keep cleanup radius by routing only runtime-created same-owner tower ruins through Vanilla's complete native obstruction cleanup.
Distinguished living tower-ruin overbuilds from ordinary tower rebuilds after prior ruin removal in diagnostics.
Replaced automatic AI tower-ruin deletion with non-mutating diagnostics for Vanilla placement, removal, and atomic replacement behavior.
Moved improved Assassin pathfinding, climbing-mode controls, and synchronized Stop cancellation from Extra Features into Bugfixes and QoL.
Added deterministic 30-second maintenance for AI tower ruins created during a running match, independent of rebuild delay and enemy proximity.
Reduced AI tower-validator diagnostics while retaining separate evidence for simultaneous blocking ruins.
Fixed AI tower-ruin replacement when Vanilla exposes incomplete or inverted ruin footprint bounds.
Prevented expected early startup deferrals for the enemy-proximity bulldoze cursor and market-goods visuals from being reported as errors or warnings.
Tooltip size test.
Added rate-limited diagnostics for AI tower placement validation and precise reasons why blocking tower ruins are accepted, rejected, or marked for safe deletion.

Fixed automatic borderless resolution changes during focused startup by protecting the values loaded from settings.cfg until Vanilla saves or the user explicitly applies a new display selection; the setting is enabled by default again.
Fixed AI tower-ruin rebuilding across map transitions by validating live blocking footprints instead of caching reusable building IDs.
Added a default-enabled AI fix that lets Vanilla tower rebuilding safely clear the AI's own blocking tower ruins.

Fixed post-game multiplayer lobby return by preparing the lobby from Vanilla's early game-over presentation signal, using Vanilla's continuation-ID transport, waiting from the first Exit click, and refreshing stale host lobby rows.
Added temporary opt-in diagnostics for display-resolution changes, including changes without focus loss, and disabled the unresolved resolution protection by default.
Added focused runtime diagnostics for the AI knight recruitment fix, including horse blocks, prevented stale equipment demands, genuine equipment shortages, and later error-free checks.
Added a default-enabled host AI Fixes setting that prevents horse-blocked knight recruitment from reusing a stale missing-weapon result and repeatedly buying and selling equipment.
Fixed the map-origin column header in singleplayer and multiplayer map selection so it sorts Steam Workshop, local, and Vanilla maps in reversible groups.
Broadened the existing selection-list enhancement setting to cover map, custom-lord, AIV, and AIC list sorting.
Supports up to 50 ordered custom AIV candidates per lord in skirmish lobbies.
Automatically transfers additional multiplayer AIV candidates from the host and imports them before Vanilla selects the best-fitting castle.
Adds a neutral candidate-status interface used optionally by CastlePlanner.
Shortened the AIV/AIC preset button toward the right so it remains left-aligned with the selected AIV list without covering rotation controls.
Made the AIV footer OK button reliably compact and right-aligned, and shortened the AIV/AIC preset button to avoid the west rotation control.
Added per-lord named presets for AIV lists, AIC configuration, and castle rotation, including save-date/name sorting and graceful handling of removed custom files.
Moved the AIV search box beside a half-width OK button so it no longer overlaps the list.
Restored Ctrl/Shift multi-selection in the AIV list by keeping Noesis keyboard input enabled only while the modal AI-settings dialog is visible.
Fixed the AIV dialog crash by preserving Vanilla GridView columns and their required header objects; the AIC power column is now appended without replacing existing UI structure.
Fixed a crash when opening the AIV/AIC dialog by applying search and sorting only after dialog initialization, while keeping visible and internal list indexes aligned for Vanilla and CastlePlanner.
Extended the custom-lord list enhancement setting with name search and sortable origin/name headers for AI castles, plus origin/name/Lord Power sorting for AI configurations.
Added a default-enabled host setting that recreates a normal multiplayer lobby after game over and returns every still-connected participant when they leave the final statistics.
Isolated native initialization and settings reconciliation per feature, and install reversible local hooks only while their individual options are enabled.
Fixed plague popularity in synchronized Chores by retaining newly created Disease projectiles while they are still in NeedsInit until the surrounding native tick completes.
Added exact serialized and decoded Surrender Chore bytes plus current-Lord snapshots to diagnose the observed remote lordGlobalId corruption.

Added focused plague-popularity diagnostics for multiplayer, including herd ownership and projectile identities, native callback player IDs, applied modifiers and accumulator values, plus a warning when no callback follows a captured herd.

Restored the standalone Leave Mission button to Vanilla's centered position whenever neither Surrender nor Statistics is visible, while preserving the widened two-button layout when either companion action is available.
Placed per-troop health text consistently above overlapping troop HUD icons without intercepting button input.
Added map-editor diagnostics for selected-unit health and prevented market UI ownership checks from querying invalid building ID zero.

Moved multiplayer game-speed controls, Ctrl single-unit market trading, and ally goods-transfer amount modifiers from Extra Features, including synchronized Chore execution and goods-multiplier integration.
Enabled selected-unit health and all market UI fixes for objects owned by the active player in the map editor.

Added a default-enabled host setting that opens a compact Vanilla troop-command HUD for the controlled Lord in matches and the map editor, shows scaled optional Lord health, returns to the appropriate Vanilla HUD after deselection, and routes in-game disband through the synchronized confirmed-surrender flow.
Increased the per-troop health text to roughly two thirds of Vanilla's troop-count font while retaining automatic resolution, UI-scale, and long-number scaling.
Replaced the combined selected-unit health total with per-troop-type current health above each visible icon and maximum health on the lower HUD strip.

Placed the selected-unit health text on the troop HUD's dark strip using resolution-independent logical coordinates and scaled displayed health by ten with integer rounding after verifying every selectable unit's default health.
Moved the selected-unit health display directly above the selected unit icons and color-coded it green, yellow, or red according to the summed health ratio.
Added a default-enabled per-player HUD display for the current and maximum health of selected units, summing both values for multi-unit selections.

Removed the unnecessarily strict native DLL hash gate from eliminated-player spectator promotion while retaining runtime mode, local-human, lord-transition, and identity validation; re-audited multiplayer surrender as an authenticated client request followed by a host-only tick-synchronized Chore with no local pre-kill or Steam fallback.

Hardened eliminated-player spectator promotion for multiplayer with explicit native-version, game-mode and local-human validation, post-transition identity checks, and diagnostic logging without network traffic.
Added a default-enabled host setting that grants eliminated players Vanilla spectator visibility and AI information without removing their player slot or changing synchronized game state.
Fixed the Statistics button not appearing for eliminated players whose Vanilla spectator flag remains unset after their lord dies.
Added host-controlled, refreshable current-match statistics for spectators without leaving the running game, and combined its setting with Surrender.
Replaced continuous startup resolution monitoring with an event-driven borderless focus guard that preserves settings.cfg while allowing explicit display-option changes.
Removed the non-Vanilla tooltips from the Surrender and Leave Mission buttons and restored Leave Mission to Vanilla's 300-pixel width whenever Surrender is unavailable.
Widened the shared Surrender and Leave Mission row, reduced the gap between both buttons, and restored the Vanilla leave-mission label and command through the registered binding host.
Added a default-enabled host option and confirmed in-game Surrender button that uses the natural lord-death, defeat, and statistics flow in singleplayer and tick-synchronized multiplayer.
Added a default-enabled host option that identifies a disconnected player during resynchronization and offers a confirmed, authoritative host kick.

Restricted the in-game Steam invitation prompt to a fully loaded frontend or active game, preventing it from appearing during loading screens, scene transitions, briefings, or an existing confirmation dialog.
Added a default-enabled local in-game prompt for incoming Steam lobby invitations, with direct acceptance through Vanilla's leave-and-join flow.
Added Vanilla's square portrait background behind the random custom-lord icon and separated it from the search box.
Added a Vanilla-styled question-mark button that adds a random custom lord from the currently visible list.
Moved the advanced random-skirmish lord-source filters slightly downward to match Vanilla's row spacing.
Added Vanilla, local, and Steam Workshop lord-source filters to both random-opponent dialogs in singleplayer and multiplayer skirmish lobbies.
Applied the mod's opaque, bordered, wrapping tooltip presentation to every custom-lord lobby tooltip.
Moved custom-lord sort headers outside Vanilla's ListView event route so header double-clicks can no longer add a lord.
Reused Vanilla's map-search placeholder for the custom-lord search box and removed its tooltip.
Prevented custom-lord column-header double-clicks from adding a lord and added Steam Workshop origin sorting.
Added a default-enabled host option with search and sortable Name and Lord Power columns for the custom-lord picker in singleplayer and multiplayer skirmish lobbies.
Added diagnosis to identify automatic game resolution reset and adjsut the fix for it later.
Added a default-enabled local startup display-resolution fix that reapplies the values loaded from settings.cfg during initialization and then fully stops monitoring.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Added an optional, default-enabled Custom Trail starting-gold fix that ignores the unusable customisedExtremeTrail flag when reading .trail files and writes it as false when saving.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Prevented early market-icon retries from constructing the game view model or interrupting mod-settings registration.
Fixed missing market-order editor icons by resolving game UI resources when the mod settings open, and hardened related UI resource access.
Added a per-player visual editor for an arbitrary detailed-market goods order, with preset persistence and the HD order as default.
Fixed local per-player preferences being repeatedly resolved through an unavailable network player ID and added the missing synchronized companion arrays.
Added separate, default-enabled settings for every previously always-active bug fix so each fix can be disabled independently.
Highlighted local and host activation controls, moved the host activation beside the Host options heading, and enlarged the shared tooltip presentation.
Separated the local client activation switch from the host-controlled fixes and reorganized the settings UI with readable wrapped tooltips.
Use validated reference RVAs on the audited DLL and reserve native signature scans for changed DLLs.
Moved confirmed apothecary-fix runtime messages to debug logging and removed temporary diagnostic overhead.
Added separate host settings for plague-cloud removal, stuck-apothecary, and apothecary target-reservation fixes.
Separated the three apothecary fixes into dedicated source files.
Prevented different apothecaries from selecting plague clouds covered by the same reserved area treatment.
Added deterministic cleanup for completed, abandoned, deleted, dead, and stalled apothecary reservations.
Fixed treated plague clouds occasionally returning to an active phase instead of fading.
Fixed apothecaries remaining in their building-exit waiting state after finding a plague target.
Fixed the authoritative popularity accumulator after natural plague-cloud expiry.
Added a host-controlled plague popularity fix: each active plague outbreak now applies exactly -1 popularity until all of its plague clouds are gone.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Added the optional per-player HD Marketview product order for the detailed market trade panel.
Split the bug fixes and quality-of-life options from Some Settings into a dedicated mod.
Added an optional movement-cadence integration used by Extra Features without duplicating native hooks.
